art_note: The model photo looks heavily composited and lacks true luxury campaign standards, though clean studio product and detail shots elevate the overall presentation
desc_en: This piece embodies nocturnal sophistication with a fluid silhouette and delicate detailing. Crafted from a soft, lightweight fabric, it offers an exceptional feel against the skin. The V-neckline enhances femininity, accented by a refined white lace trim. Adjustable shoulder straps allow for a customized fit and absolute comfort. Designed for moments of repose or private elegance, this nightgown combines a polished aesthetic with subtle sensuality. Available for worldwide shipping with ultimate exclusivity.
desc_es: Esta pieza encarna la sofisticación nocturna con una silueta fluida y detalles delicados. Confeccionada con un tejido suave y ligero, ofrece una sensación excepcional sobre la piel. El escote en V realza la feminidad, acentuado por un refinado ribete de encaje blanco. Los tirantes ajustables permiten una adaptación personalizada para un confort absoluto. Diseñado para momentos de descanso o elegancia privada, este camisón combina una estética depurada con una sensualidad sutil. Disponible para envío a todo el mundo con la máxima exclusividad.
details_en:
· 95% polyester, 5% spandex
· White lace trim along the neckline
· Adjustable shoulder straps
· Made to order with worldwide shipping available
details_es:
